title: Concept: Package.resolved pin that follows a branch
description: Package.resolved declares a resolved pin whose state keeps a branch name, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a resolved pin whose state keeps a branch name.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Package.resolved (swift).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a resolved pin whose state keeps a branch name.
